players.bio: Alyssa Thomas (born April 12, 1992) is an American professional basketball forward for the Phoenix Mercury of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA). She played college basketball for the Maryland Terrapins.

DeWanna Bonner (born August 21, 1987) is an American-Macedonian professional basketball player for the Phoenix Mercury of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA). Bonner played college basketball for Auburn University. After a successful college career at Auburn, she was drafted by the Mercury with the fifth overall pick of the 2009 WNBA draft, and was traded to the Sun in 2020.

Kahleah Copper (/kəˈliːə/ kə-LEE-ə; born August 28, 1994) is an American professional basketball player for the Phoenix Mercury of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA). She was drafted with the seventh overall pick by the Washington Mystics in 2016, and was traded to the Chicago Sky the next year.

Kalani Brown (born March 21, 1997) is an American professional basketball player for the Phoenix Mercury of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and for Inner Mongolia of the Women's Chinese Basketball Association (WCBA).

Marta Suárez Rodríguez (born May 7, 2002) is a Spanish professional basketball player for the Phoenix Mercury of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA). She played college basketball for the Tennessee Lady Volunteers, California Golden Bears, and TCU Horned Frogs.
Nate Tibbetts (born May 15, 1977) is an American basketball coach who is the current head coach of the Phoenix Mercury of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA).

Samantha Allison Whitcomb (born July 20, 1988) is an American-Australian professional basketball player for the Perry Lakes Hawks of the NBL1 West and the Phoenix Mercury of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA).

Isatou "Satou" Sabally (born April 25, 1998) is a German-American professional basketball player for the Phoenix Mercury of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA). She started playing as an amateur in the German second division, and later in the 1. Damen-Basketball-Bundesliga.

Sevgi Uzun (born 25 November 1997) is a Turkish professional basketball player for the Phoenix Mercury of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and for Fenerbahçe of Turkish Super League, EuroLeague Women and Turkish national team. She is 1.78 m tall and plays the point guard position in both her Turkish league team Fenerbahçe and her WNBA team Phoenix Mercury .
